instruction: Create a user-level service for a personal sync tool.
Enable lingering so a user service runs without an active login.
Start and inspect a user service.
output:
systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable --now sync.service
systemctl --user status sync.service

instruction: Create a user timer that runs every 30 minutes.
Use %h and %u specifiers in a user unit.
Set a user unit's environment file.
Import environment variables from the user session.
output:
[Service]
ExecStart=%h/bin/app
# To pass the graphical session env:
systemctl --user import-environment DISPLAY WAYLAND_DISPLAY

instruction: Create a user service that must run after the graphical session.
List all user services and timers.
Reload a user daemon after editing a unit.
Explain the difference between system and user managers.
output:
# System manager: /etc/systemd/system, root, systemctl
# User manager:   ~/.config/systemd/user, per-user, systemctl --user
# User services cannot normally bind <1024 ports or manage system-wide resources.

instruction: View user service logs.
Run a user service only while a session is active.
output:
# Omit enable-linger so the service stops at logout
[Service]
ExecStart=%h/bin/session-task

instruction: Enable a user unit to start at login.
output:
systemctl --user enable sync.service
# Requires the user manager; ensure it is started:
systemctl --user start default.target

instruction: Create a user socket-activated service.
output:
# ~/.config/systemd/user/app.socket
[Socket]
ListenStream=%t/app.sock

[Install]
WantedBy=sockets.target

# The matching app.service uses standard input sockets.

instruction: Pass the systemd user runtime directory to a service.
Troubleshoot why a user service exits immediately.
output:
systemctl --user status sync.service
journalctl --user -u sync.service -n 100
# Common causes: missing PATH, %h not expanded, missing dependencies

instruction: Set memory limits on a user service.
Use a drop-in to override a user unit.
output:
# ~/.config/systemd/user/sync.service.d/override.conf
[Service]
Environment=VERBOSE=1
# then: systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user restart sync.service
